title: Update on Community Petition Related to Road Safety on Highways 35, 84, and 9 - NewsBreak
text: 1 days ago The Town has received extensive communication from community members in and near Portola Valley voicing concerns about vehicle speeds and behavior on Highways 35, 84, and 9. The emails request that representatives and agencies that oversee these highways designate them as a safety corridor, construct roadway improvements, and provide enforcement. State Assemblymembers Berman and Pellerin, Senator Becker, and County of San Mateo Supervisor Mueller sent a letter to Caltrans on July 30, 2026. The letter requested a comprehensive corridor safety review of State Routes 35, 84, and 9 in San Mateo and Santa Clara Counties and forwarded a list of 16 recommended safety improvements developed by local officials, community organizations, and the South Coast Traffic Advisory Panel.
